releases.title: Security and Studio updates
releases.summary: Fixes malformed date-function calls that could terminate the daemon; adds session panic containment, compiler/dependency security updates, and automatic native SQL completion in Studio.
highlights: Wrong date-function arity returns invalid_argument; unexpected session panics close the affected connection and run cleanup
Patched Go toolchains, docs dependencies, and SQL-reference extraction
Consistent Admin presentation and automatic native SQL completion with capability-aware feature notes

changes.text: Validate exact arity for EXTRACT, DATE_TRUNC, DATE_ADD, and DATE_DIFF before indexing or NULL propagation.
Contain recoverable serving-goroutine panics, close the affected connection, and run transaction/session cleanup without logging panic payloads.
Require Go 1.26.10 for native builds, use Go 1.27.3 for containers, and patch docs dependencies and the SQL-reference generator regex.
Use consistent Admin components across Setup, Operations, and Studio.
Open native SQL completion automatically in Studio and annotate feature availability from the connected server.
Correct the Node TypeScript smoke-test configuration; Node and Bun runtime packages remain unchanged at 0.0.1.

releases.title: First public preview
releases.summary: The first public release of NextSQL: one encrypted ACID engine for SQL, JSON, vectors, full-text, and geo, with official drivers at 0.0.1.
highlights: One WAL, one MVCC, and one optimizer for SQL, JSON, vectors, full-text, and geo
AES-256-GCM envelope encryption and group-commit WAL with page-delta redo
Official Go, Node, Bun, PHP, Python, and Ruby drivers at 0.0.1

changes.text: Clustered B+Tree storage, group-commit WAL, and fsync before commit is acknowledged.
Hybrid SELECT: filters, SEARCH (BM25), and NEAREST (ANN) in one physical plan with reciprocal rank fusion.
Native JSON columns (NSJB) with path extract and path indexes.
VECTOR<F32,N> with flat and HNSW indexes.
Inverted full-text index, BM25 ranking, and phrase queries.
WGS84 POINT, BOX, LINESTRING, and POLYGON, plus GEOMETRY and GEOGRAPHY.
Envelope encryption, TLS 1.3 off loopback, password auth, and RBAC.
Three-voter Raft, quorum commits, and encrypted replication.
nextsql init/setup/exec/migrate and nextsqld with --key-file off the data volume.
Official Go, Node, Bun, PHP, Python, and Ruby drivers at 0.0.1 (npm @bzync/nextsql, Composer bzync/nextsql, PyPI/RubyGems bzync-nextsql). Keys never go in a URL.
Page-delta WAL redo: a commit logs only the bytes that changed, about 8× less disk writing per insert, without weakening fsync.
Native Windows packages are not shipped. On Windows, run the Linux packages inside WSL 2.
